id./param/region/r008.pack|book_ie.bxon|4b4: The once-great Bandelfon was ruled by Arthur, the young and wise king known as the Golden Lion King.
id./param/region/r008.pack|book_ie.bxon|4bf: King Arthur kept a mighty order of knights to protect his people. Putting them first, he was beloved.
id./param/region/r008.pack|book_ie.bxon|4d3: But that glory did not last. Monsters suddenly attacked the kingdom. King Arthur led his knights, but...
id./param/region/r008.pack|book_ie.bxon|4e5: Despite the fight, the kingdom fell. It is said monsters feared Bandelfon's military might, but the truth is unknown.
id./param/region/r008.pack|book_ie.bxon|4f4: From the fleeting ruins, King Arthur's regretful voice still seems to echo. That tragedy must never be forgotten.

tm.「なんて 美しい木なの……。\n 見ていると 心が洗われるようだわ。: "What a beautiful tree... Just looking at it cleanses my heart.

tm.「でも なんで そんなことを……。\n ふたりは 深い信頼で結ばれた\n 戦友だ: "But why would he... They were comrades bound by deep trust.
tm.「預言者は 魔法使いウラノスだったのね。\n でも ローシュさまを裏切った人が\: "The prophet was the wizard Uranos. But why would the man who betrayed Erdwin guide us...
tm.「導きの木に姿を変え 勇者を導く。\n それが あのふたり……勇者の導き手となる: "Becoming Guiding Trees to guide the Luminary. That was the true mission of the fated twin guides.
tm.「{var:1} いよいよ\n ローシュたちの記憶の核心に 迫っておるぞ。\n: "{var:1}, we're closing in on the core of Erdwin's memories. Now, read the memory from that tree.

tm.「だが これには まだ続きがあるようじゃな。\n {var:1} もう一度\n: "But it seems there is more. {var:1}, hold your hand over the Guiding Tree again.

tm.「これほどのチカラを持つ\n 預言者とは いったい 何者なのだ。\n とても 常: "Who is this prophet with such power? He hardly seems an ordinary man...

tm.{var:1}は 辺りを見回してみた。\n金色の小麦畑を 風が揺らしている。\n: {var:1} looked around. The wind sways the golden wheat fields... Somehow, the heart grows calmer.
tm.{var:1}は 辺りを見回してみた。\n美しい 森の木々が 風に揺られている。: {var:1} looked around. The wind sways the beautiful forest trees... Somehow, the heart grows calmer.
tm.ひどく ふるびた ちいさな墓だ。\nよく見ると 墓石には かすれた文字で\n詩の: A tiny, very old grave. Looking closely, faded writing like a poem is carved on the gravestone.
tm.{var:1}は 辺りを見回してみた。\n金色の小麦畑を 風が揺らしている。\n: {var:1} looked around. The wind sways the golden wheat fields... Somehow, the heart grows calmer.
tm.虹色の枝が かがやきだした！: The rainbow branch began to shine!
tm.『はるか遠き故郷 バンデルフォン』という本だ。: It's a book called "Faraway Homeland: Bandelfon."
tm.かつての大国 バンデルフォンは\n黄金の獅子王と呼ばれた\n若き名君 アーサーが: The once-great Bandelfon was ruled by Arthur, the young and wise king known as the Golden Lion King.
tm.アーサー王は 民の生活が守られるよう\n優秀な兵士を育て 強力な騎士団を有するな: King Arthur kept a mighty order of knights to protect his people. Putting them first, he was beloved.
tm.しかし その栄華は 長くは続かなかった。\n突然 魔物たちが現れ 王国を襲ったの: But that glory did not last. Monsters suddenly attacked the kingdom. King Arthur led his knights, but...
tm.攻防むなしく 王国は滅び去った。\n魔物たちは バンデルフォンの軍事力をおそれ\: Despite the fight, the kingdom fell. It is said monsters feared Bandelfon's military might, but the truth is unknown.
tm.はかなく散った 王国の跡地からは 今でも\nアーサー王の無念の声が 聞こえてくる: From the fleeting ruins, King Arthur's regretful voice still seems to echo. That tragedy must never be forgotten.
tm.「パープルオーブが 手に入るなんて\n やったわね {var:1}ちゃん！\n: "You got the Purple orb! Way to go, {var:1}! I'm glad it survived!
tm.「さあ {var:1}ちゃん！\n この調子で 残りのオーブも\n 手に入れちゃ: "Come on, {var:1}! At this rate, let's get the rest of the orbs too!
tm.「ジャコラに襲われたのは 災難でげしたね……。\n とはいえ ウワサの ネルセン: "Jarvis's attack was a calamity... Still, we reached Champs Sauvages, home of the famed Warrior's Rest Inn.
tm.「シルビアねえさんの船は 無傷でがす！\n 船に乗りたい時は\n あっしに お声: "Sylvando's ship is unscathed! If you want to sail, just talk to me!
tm.「{var:1}のダンナが ジャコラを倒したから\n 海も すこしだけ 元気にな: "Since you beat Jarvis, boss, the sea seems a little livelier. I wonder what became of the undersea kingdom.
tm.「いやぁ～ いい波でげす！\n これも アニキが 魔王を倒したおかげでがす！\n: "What a fine wave! It's all thanks to the boss defeating Mordegon! Let's sail the open sea!
tm.聖なる波動と 不屈の刃が 交差するとき\nまばゆき 光の星雲が生まれ\n闇に閉ざ: When holy resonance and an unyielding blade cross, a nebula of light is born and fills the dark world with hope.
tm.{var:1}は 絵画の前にある石碑を読んだ。: {var:1} read the stone tablet before the painting.
tm.『降誕』\n神話の時代の すべての始まりとなる一枚\n伝説の勇者 ローシュの誕生: "The Nativity": the painting from which all began in the age of myth. A holy portrait of the legendary Luminary Erdwin's birth.
tm.『災厄』\nこの世の命の すべての根源となる\n命の大樹が 散りゆく姿を描いた聖: "Calamity": a sacred painting of Yggdrasil, the root of all life in this world, scattering.
tm.『対峙』\n伝説の勇者ローシュと その仲間たちが\n邪神に挑む姿を 描いた聖画: "Confrontation": a sacred painting of the legendary Luminary Erdwin and his companions facing the evil god.
tm.『星天』\n平和となった ロトゼタシアの世界に\n勇者の星が浮かぶところを 描い: "Starry Heavens": a sacred painting of the Luminary's Star floating over a peaceful Erdrea.
tm.剣をかまえた 男性の石像がある。\n像には 伝説の勇者ローシュと刻まれている。: A stone statue of a man holding a sword. The statue is inscribed "Legendary Luminary Erdwin."
tm.杖を持った 女性の石像がある。\n像には 賢者セニカと刻まれている。: A stone statue of a woman with a staff. The statue is inscribed "Sage Senya."
tm.ローブを着た 男性の石像がある。\n像には 魔法使いウラノスと刻まれている。: A stone statue of a man in robes. The statue is inscribed "Wizard Uranos."
tm.なんと 虹色の枝が 強く光りだした。\nどうやら この近くに オーブがあるようだ: The rainbow branch began to glow strongly. An orb seems to be nearby.
tm.ここより北 グロッタの町\n西に見えるは バンデルフォン王国跡: North: Octagonia. West: the Bandelfon Kingdom ruins.
